hints: For each value you look at, there is exactly one other value that would complete the pair. Can you name it without searching for it?
The partner of `values[i]` is `target - values[i]`. The question is whether you have already walked past it.
Walk the array once, keeping a map from value to the index where you first saw it. Before recording `values[i]`, ask the map whether its partner is already there.
Check for the partner *before* inserting the current value, or an element will happily pair with itself.
